recipes.title: Greek Yogurt with Fresh Orange Segments, Walnuts & Honey
recipes.summary: Cool creamy Greek yogurt topped with juicy raw orange segments, warm cinnamon, chopped walnuts, and a light drizzle of honey.

ingredient_details.note: peeled and sliced into bite-sized segments

steps: Peel the sweet orange, remove excess white pith, and slice into tender bite-sized pieces.
Spoon Greek yogurt into a shallow bowl and arrange fresh orange segments on top.
Scatter chopped walnuts, cinnamon, torn mint, and honey over the bowl.
tips: Using seedless navel oranges or easy-peel clementines keeps morning prep gentle on hands.
Warm cinnamon and bright citrus are a classic Moroccan breakfast pairing.

recipes.title: Orange Zest, Almond & Honey Warm Rolled Oats
recipes.summary: Fragrant warm oatmeal perfumed with fresh orange zest and topped with raw orange pieces, sliced almonds, and vanilla.

ingredient_details.note: 1 tsp zest grated, flesh peeled and diced

steps: Zest the washed orange before peeling it, then dice the juicy raw segments.
Simmer rolled oats, milk, and half the orange zest for 6 to 7 minutes until soft and creamy; stir in vanilla.
Spoon into a bowl and top with fresh raw orange pieces, remaining zest, sliced almonds, and honey.
tips: Zesting before peeling is much easier and gives aromatic citrus oil right into the warm oats.
Pair with a sprinkle of dark chocolate shavings for an orange-mocha feel.

recipes.title: Whipped Ricotta, Raw Orange & Olive Oil Toast
recipes.summary: Crisp whole-grain toast spread with creamy ricotta and crowned with thin raw orange slices, olive oil, honey, and black pepper.

ingredient_details.note: peeled and sliced into thin rounds

steps: Slice off the orange peel with a sharp knife and cut the raw fruit into thin rounds.
Toast whole-grain bread and spread generously with ricotta cheese.
Lay raw orange slices over top and finish with extra-virgin olive oil, honey, and a tiny grind of black pepper.
tips: A serrated bread knife slices peeled oranges cleanly without squishing out the juice.
Extra-virgin olive oil and sweet orange are a beloved Southern Italian morning combination.

recipes.title: Orange Creamsicle Vanilla & Chia Overnight Oats
recipes.summary: Make-ahead creamy oats soaked with fresh orange juice, zest, Greek yogurt, vanilla, and chia seeds, topped with fresh segments.

ingredient_details.note: 1 juiced + zested, 1 peeled and diced for topping

steps: Stir rolled oats, fresh orange juice, orange zest, Greek yogurt, milk, chia seeds, and vanilla in two jars.
Cover and chill overnight until creamy and bright.
Top with freshly diced raw orange segments in the morning.
tips: No morning prep required — just open the jar and spoon on fresh orange.
Naturally bright and gently sweet.

recipes.title: Sliced Orange, Creamy Avocado & Soft-Boiled Egg Plate
recipes.summary: Balanced savory-bright breakfast plate featuring raw orange slices, ripe avocado, soft-cooked egg, olive oil, and black pepper.
steps: Soft-boil the egg for 7 minutes, cool under cold water, peel, and halve.
Arrange raw orange rounds and sliced avocado on a plate beside the warm egg.
Drizzle everything lightly with olive oil, cracked black pepper, and chopped parsley.
tips: Juicy citrus and creamy avocado make a naturally moist, easy-to-eat savory breakfast.
Pre-boil a few eggs at the start of the week for instant assembly.

recipes.title: Sicilian Raw Orange, Celery Stalk & Olive Oil Salad
recipes.summary: Classic Sicilian citrus salad pairing juicy raw orange rounds with thinly sliced celery stalk, sweet red onion, mint, olive oil, and black pepper.
steps: Cut the peel and white pith away from the oranges and slice crosswise into bright rounds.
Arrange orange rounds on a platter with thinly shaved celery stalk and paper-thin red onion.
Drizzle generously with extra-virgin olive oil and finish with cracked black pepper and torn mint.
tips: Save any juice on the cutting board and spoon it right over the salad.
Pairs wonderfully with canned tuna, white beans, or crusty bread.

recipes.title: Moroccan Orange, Grated Carrot & Chickpea Salad
recipes.summary: Vibrant no-cook bowl of finely grated sweet carrots, chickpeas, raw orange segments, cumin, cinnamon, olive oil, and cilantro.
steps: Whisk fresh orange juice, olive oil, ground cumin, and cinnamon in a mixing bowl.
Toss finely grated carrots, rinsed chickpeas, and chopped cilantro in the bright citrus dressing.
Fold in raw orange segments gently and serve chilled.
tips: Store-bought shredded carrots make this a zero-grating 5-minute lunch.
Tastes even better after chilling for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Baby Spinach, Raw Orange, Avocado & Walnut Bowl
recipes.summary: Tender baby spinach tossed in fresh orange-olive oil vinaigrette with sweet orange segments, creamy avocado, toasted walnuts, and black pepper.
steps: Whisk fresh orange juice, extra-virgin olive oil, and cracked black pepper in a large bowl.
Add tender baby spinach and toss gently until lightly glossy.
Arrange raw orange segments, sliced avocado, and toasted walnuts over top.
tips: Fresh orange juice makes a mild, low-acid dressing that is gentle on sensitive stomachs.
Add poached chicken or white beans for extra protein.

recipes.title: Ginger-Orange Quinoa, Cucumber & Edamame Bowl
recipes.summary: Fluffy chilled quinoa tossed with shelled edamame, crisp cucumber, fresh raw orange pieces, sesame oil, ginger, and soy sauce.
steps: Whisk fresh orange juice, sesame oil, reduced-sodium soy sauce, and grated ginger in a bowl.
Fold in cooled quinoa, shelled edamame, diced cucumber, and chopped cilantro.
Gently fold in juicy raw orange pieces and serve chilled.
tips: Frozen shelled edamame thaws in 2 minutes under warm tap water for easy plant protein.
Packs cleanly for next-day lunches.

recipes.title: Sesame-Orange Poached Chicken & Crisp Greens Bowl
recipes.summary: Tender shredded chicken over crisp greens with sweet raw orange segments, shaved carrot, sliced almonds, and ginger-orange dressing.
steps: Whisk fresh orange juice, sesame oil, grated ginger, and 1 tablespoon water until emulsified.
Toss torn lettuce and shredded carrot with half the dressing.
Top with shredded poached chicken, raw orange segments, sliced almonds, and the remaining citrus dressing.
tips: Light, bright, and completely no-cook when using pre-poached chicken.
Mandarin oranges or clementines work effortlessly here too.

recipes.title: Baked Orange, Rosemary & Olive Oil Salmon
recipes.summary: Juicy oven-baked salmon roasted over fragrant orange rounds with fresh rosemary, garlic, olive oil, and freshly cracked black pepper.

ingredient_details.note: 1 sliced into rounds, 1 peeled and diced raw for garnish

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Lay sliced orange rounds and rosemary sprigs in a baking dish.
Place salmon fillets on top of the orange slices, drizzle with olive oil, and scatter sliced garlic and black pepper over the fish.
Bake 12 to 14 minutes until flaky, then serve topped with cool diced raw orange for bright fresh contrast.
tips: Baking salmon directly on orange slices keeps the bottom moist and prevents sticking.
Serving raw diced orange on top brings lively fresh citrus aroma.

recipes.title: Bright Ginger-Orange Glazed Chicken & Broccoli
recipes.summary: Quick weeknight skillet pairing tender chicken and crisp broccoli in a fresh orange juice, ginger, garlic, and sesame oil glaze.
steps: Whisk fresh orange juice, zest, reduced-sodium soy sauce, grated ginger, and minced garlic in a small bowl.
Sear chicken pieces in sesame oil over medium-high heat for 5 minutes until golden, then add broccoli florets and 2 tablespoons water, covering 2 minutes to steam bright green.
Pour in the orange-ginger sauce and simmer 3 minutes until glossy; serve over warm rice topped with fresh raw orange segments.
tips: Fresh orange zest gives true restaurant-quality citrus flavor without refined sugar.
Cutting broccoli florets small helps them steam tender quickly.

recipes.title: Velvety Sweet Potato, Fresh Orange & Ginger Soup
recipes.summary: Silky, easy-to-swallow golden soup blending tender sweet potato, sauteed onion, fresh ginger, olive oil, and bright raw orange juice.
steps: Saute chopped onion, garlic, and grated ginger in olive oil for 5 minutes until fragrant.
Add cubed sweet potato and broth, cover, and simmer 15 minutes until completely tender.
Puree silky smooth with an immersion blender, then stir in fresh raw orange juice, zest, and black pepper off the heat.
tips: Adding fresh orange juice after turning off the stove keeps its bright vitamin-rich citrus aroma alive.
Freezes smoothly in single-serving portions.

recipes.title: Crispy Orange-Garlic Tofu & Spinach Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Golden pan-seared tofu glazed in fresh orange juice, garlic, ginger, and black pepper over warm rice and tender spinach.
steps: Brown cubed tofu in olive oil for 6 minutes until lightly crisp on the edges.
Add minced garlic, grated ginger, fresh orange juice, orange zest, and black pepper, tossing 2 minutes until glazed.
Fold baby spinach into the hot skillet to wilt lightly, then serve over warm rice garnished with raw orange segments.
tips: Pressing moisture from tofu for 5 minutes with a clean towel gives crisp edges fast.
A splash of reduced-sodium soy sauce deepens the savory glaze if desired.

recipes.title: Baked Cod with Fresh Orange, Thyme & Tomato
recipes.summary: Moist baked white fish simmered in a light dish of juicy orange pieces, cherry tomatoes, onion, thyme, olive oil, and black pepper.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Scatter halved tomatoes, thinly sliced onion, thyme, olive oil, and orange juice in a baking dish.
Nestle cod fillets into the dish, season with black pepper, and bake 13 to 15 minutes until cod flakes gently.
Top the warm dish with cool raw orange segments right before bringing to the table.
tips: Sweet orange juice mellows tomato acidity for a delicate, comforting pan sauce.
Serve with crusty whole-grain bread or warm couscous.

recipes.title: Creamy Raw Orange, Vanilla & Greek Yogurt Smoothie
recipes.summary: Frosty creamsicle smoothie blending peeled raw orange, plain Greek yogurt, half a banana, pure vanilla, and chilled milk.
steps: Peel the sweet orange cleanly, pulling away any thick white pith.
Combine milk, Greek yogurt, peeled orange, banana, and vanilla in a blender.
Blend on high for 50 seconds until smooth, creamy, and lightly frothy.
tips: Blending the whole peeled orange keeps all the natural citrus fiber in your smoothie.
Add 3 to 4 ice cubes if using a room-temperature banana.

recipes.title: Sunny Orange, Carrot, Ginger & Turmeric Smoothie
recipes.summary: Bright golden smoothie blending raw orange, sweet carrot, fresh ginger, turmeric, a pinch of black pepper, and coconut water.
steps: Place chilled coconut water, grated carrot, peeled orange, ginger, turmeric, and black pepper into a blender.
Blend on high for 60 seconds until completely smooth and luminous gold.
Serve immediately over ice.
tips: Using pre-shredded carrots helps standard blenders turn them velvety smooth.
Sweet orange keeps the ginger-turmeric warmth gentle and bright.

recipes.title: Bright Orange, Baby Spinach & Pineapple Green Smoothie
recipes.summary: Fresh emerald smoothie pairing peeled raw orange with sweet pineapple chunks, baby spinach, fresh mint, and cold water.
steps: Add cold water and baby spinach to the blender and blend 15 seconds until smooth.
Add peeled orange, frozen pineapple chunks, and mint leaves.
Blend on high for 45 seconds until frosty and silky.
tips: Citrus and pineapple make fresh spinach taste completely bright and tropical.
Great hydrating mid-morning refresher.

recipes.title: Chocolate-Orange Rolled Oat & Almond Smoothie
recipes.summary: Indulgent yet light chocolate-citrus smoothie blending raw orange, orange zest, unsweetened cocoa, rolled oats, banana, and almond milk.
steps: Add almond milk, rolled oats, cocoa powder, peeled orange, zest, and banana to a blender.
Blend on high for 60 seconds until smooth and velvety.
Pour chilled and enjoy immediately.
tips: That half-teaspoon of orange zest gives genuine dark-chocolate-orange aroma.
Filling enough for breakfast or an afternoon snack.

recipes.title: Fresh Orange, Raspberry & Banana Smoothie
recipes.summary: Lively sunset-pink smoothie blending raw sweet orange, raspberries, ripe banana, Greek yogurt, and chilled water.
steps: Combine cold water, Greek yogurt, peeled orange, raspberries, and banana in a blender.
Blend on high for 50 seconds until vivid pink and completely smooth.
Serve immediately.
tips: Sweet orange softens tart raspberries without needing honey.
Strain briefly through a mesh if you prefer no berry seeds.

recipes.title: Freshly Squeezed Orange & Mint Morning Juice
recipes.summary: Pure hand-pressed sweet raw orange juice finished with lightly muddled fresh mint and a tiny splash of lemon.
steps: Roll each orange gently on the counter with your palm to loosen the juice, then slice in half.
Squeeze fresh juice into a pitcher and stir in a teaspoon of fresh lemon juice.
Pour over chilled glasses with a gently bruised mint leaf.
tips: Room-temperature oranges yield noticeably more juice than straight-from-the-fridge oranges.
An electric citrus press makes juicing effortless on tired hands.

recipes.title: Classic Sweet Orange, Carrot & Ginger Cold Press
recipes.summary: Bright gold breakfast press combining raw oranges, sweet carrots, fresh ginger root, and a squeeze of lemon.
steps: Peel oranges and scrub carrots and fresh ginger.
Juice carrots, ginger, and oranges together (or blend with 1/2 cup water and strain smooth).
Stir in fresh lemon juice and serve cold.
tips: One of the most beloved everyday fresh juices — naturally sweet and bright.
Drink fresh for peak flavor and color.

recipes.title: Sweet Orange, Celery Stalk & Cucumber Cooler
recipes.summary: Crisp, hydrating blend of freshly juiced raw oranges, celery stalk, cool cucumber, and fresh basil.
steps: Wash celery stalk, cucumber, and basil, and peel the oranges.
Juice all produce together (or blend with 1/2 cup cold water and strain clear).
Serve immediately over ice.
tips: Sweet oranges transform celery and cucumber into an effortless, refreshing glass.
Peeling oranges removes bitter oils from the rind.

recipes.title: Ruby Orange, Beet & Crisp Apple Juice
recipes.summary: Jewel-red pressed juice pairing sweet raw oranges with crisp apple, scrubbed red beet, and fresh ginger.
steps: Peel oranges and scrub and quarter the raw beet and apple.
Alternate feeding beet, ginger, apple, and oranges through the juicer (or blend with 3/4 cup water and strain).
Stir well and serve cold.
tips: Citrus brightness lifts the earthy sweetness of fresh red beet.
Serve over ice for a crisp afternoon tonic.

recipes.title: Zesty Orange, Turmeric & Black Pepper Wellness Tonic
recipes.summary: Invigorating fresh-squeezed orange juice whisked with fresh ginger, turmeric, lemon, a pinch of black pepper, and cold water.
equipment: Small whisk or jar with lid
steps: Juice the fresh oranges and lemon into a jar.
Add grated ginger, ground turmeric, a pinch of black pepper, and cold water.
Shake vigorously (or whisk well), strain if desired, and pour into chilled glasses.
tips: Shaking in a covered jar suspends the turmeric evenly without dirtying a blender.
Give a quick swirl before the last few sips.
